item.title: A Deep Dive into the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
item.description:
Author: Alessandro Pignati
Date: December 19, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Autonomous Systems", "OWASP", "Agentic Applications", "Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities"]
Summary:
  • Agentic Applications are autonomous AI systems performing multi-step tasks.
  • Existing OWASP LLM security guidelines are insufficient.
  • OWASP published a new Top 10 for Agentic Applications in 2026.
  • Key risks include Agent Goal Hijack and excessive autonomy vulnerabilities.
  • Security principles include Least-Agency and Strong Observability.
  • The article details these threats and architectural security recommendations.
